findings.summary: Root cause is wrong: std is_terminal already detects mintty; no observed repro
Env-var-only mintty check sends ANSI color into pipes and files (MSYSTEM set regardless of stdout)
Body and changelog claim fix for normal file display, but only --help branch changes
Body contradicts code comment about interactive_output
Testing claims don't cover the change; no test added
Comments read machine-written and repeat the wrong explanation
Lean: cfg! expression, is_some_and, trim comment

why: Finding 2 says the env-var check treats mintty as interactive regardless of stdout and puts color into pipes, which is the maintainer's reason. It ranks second behind the root-cause finding.
